observation_order.value: unit gravity vector projected into body coordinates, R_world_from_body.T @ [0,0,-1]
joint position minus default; last four wheel position entries forced to zero
joint angular velocity rad/s in joint_order
previous raw policy output, before target scaling

action_decode.previous_action: keep raw output for next observation, continuous across height changes

reset: Only genuine reset clears previous_action to zeros; changing height is not a reset. DEFAULT_Q remains the W5 offset at all commanded heights.

nominal_simulated_actuators.note: These describe the trained/simulated controller, not authorization to overwrite hardware settings.

runtime_adapter: w5_inference.py: unchanged byte-identical adapter validated in TH3F08 and TH3F11 MuJoCo rollouts; observation/action conversion only.
known_limits: No complete TH3F08/TH3F09 306-case multi-load full-motion acceptance.
Parking has residual drift; TH3F08 mean final displacement0.953m after112s in six paired trials.
Fast +/-2.5m/s direction changes caused simulated wheel speeds beyond42.94rad/s; TH3F08 maximum67.575rad/s. Do not infer validated hardware high-speed reversal from nominal limit.
0.15m low-height yaw tracking remains imperfect, e.g. final4s of +0.5rad/s command has0.178rad/s MAE in the available demo.
